gui-hint: Changes apply immediately. Hover a setting for details, right-click it to reset. Ctrl+Click a slider to type any value, negative values invert an effect.
gui-revert-desc: Discard unsaved changes and read the config file again.
gui-defaults-desc: Set every value to its default. Nothing is written until you save or close the window.
gui-reload-failed: ModConfig/{0} could not be read, the current settings are kept. A copy of the broken file was saved as {1}.
gui-contexts-hint: Each profile is used in its own situation, and switching between them is smoothly blended. Priority: boats and vehicles, mounts, swimming, glider, flying, climbing, sprinting, walking.
gui-sounds-hint: Sounds whose name contains the given text shake the screen near them, the first matching entry wins. Explosions are recognized by their sound too.
setting-enabled-desc: Toggles all of the mod's features.
setting-enableinthirdperson-desc: Disable this to make the effects exclusive to the first-person view.
setting-aimfollowscamera-desc: Targets blocks and creatures through the center of the screen, so the crosshair always marks what you interact with, even while the camera lags behind a fast turn. Turn off to target along the vanilla look direction, like the original mod does. Arrows and thrown items always fly along the vanilla look direction.
setting-effectsintensity-desc: Scales every effect at once: tilts, sway, landings, hits and screen shakes. The camera smoothing is not affected. 0 turns the effects off, 2 doubles them.
setting-contexttransitionsmoothing-desc: How smooth transitions between movement profiles, such as walking and swimming, should be. 0 switches instantly.
setting-turningrollaccumulation-desc: Sensitivity of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-turningrollintensity-desc: Maximum strength of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-turningrollsmoothing-desc: Smoothness of the decay of the camera roll caused by turning around horizontally.
setting-cameraswayintensity-desc: Strength of the smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfrequency-desc: Frequency of the smooth random sway that kicks in when the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfadeindelay-desc: How long the player must idle before the sway starts to fade in.
setting-cameraswayfadeinlength-desc: How long it takes the sway to fully fade in once the player idles for long enough.
setting-cameraswayfadeoutlength-desc: How long it takes the sway to fade out when the player starts moving again.
setting-screenshakesmaxintensity-desc: Maximum strength of all screen shakes, in degrees. 0 disables screen shakes.
setting-screenshakesmaxfrequency-desc: How fast screen shakes change direction or oscillate.
setting-respectgameshakesetting: Use the game's camera shake setting
setting-respectgameshakesetting-desc: Scales all screen shakes by the "Camera shake strength" slider in the game's accessibility settings, so 0% there turns them off.
setting-lightningtrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake caused by lightning strikes within 16 blocks.
setting-thundertrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the long rumble caused by lightning strikes within 192 blocks.
setting-handswingtrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake caused by attacking, breaking and placing blocks. Best kept very low.
setting-convertvanillashakes-desc: The game shakes the camera itself when you take damage, hit with some weapons, throw a spear, use translocators, during temporal storms and for some server effects. With this on, those shakes become smooth screen shakes of this mod.
setting-suppressvanillashakejitter-desc: The game's own shake jerks the camera position back and forth. Turn this off to keep it on top of the smooth shake. While the camera effects are off, the game's shake always plays.
setting-vanillashaketraumascale-desc: Converts the game's shake strength into the trauma of the smooth shake. For reference, taking damage is 0.3 and translocating is 0.9.
setting-sound-desc: Part of the sound's asset path, for example effect/rockslide. Not case-sensitive, empty entries are ignored.
setting-soundtrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake caused by this sound.
setting-soundradiusfromexplosionrange-de: Derive the radius from the range of the sound, the way the game sets it for explosions: bigger explosions are felt from farther away.
setting-soundradius-desc: Distance in blocks at which the shake fades out. Never larger than the distance the sound can be heard from.
setting-soundlength-desc: How long the shake takes to fade out.
setting-soundfrequency-desc: Speed of the shake, relative to the screen shake max frequency.
setting-landingpitchintensity-desc: How far the camera dips after a fall at full strength, in degrees. Full strength is reached when landing at twice the threshold speed.
setting-landingtrauma-desc: A 0 to 1 value linked to the strength of the screen shake after a hard landing.
setting-landingthreshold-desc: Fall speed above which landings affect the camera. 0.5 is a drop of about 2.5 blocks, normal jumps stay below it.
setting-hurtkickintensity-desc: How far a hit of 6 damage knocks the camera, in degrees. Hits from the side tilt the camera, hits from the front throw the view up.
setting-maxvelocitypitch-desc: Soft limit of the camera pitch caused by moving, in degrees, so that fast creative flight or mounts don't tilt the view too far. Smaller tilts are not affected. 0 disables the limit.
setting-maxvelocityroll-desc: Soft limit of the camera roll caused by strafing, in degrees. Smaller tilts are not affected. 0 disables the limit.
setting-strafingrollfactor-desc: Strength of the camera roll caused by strafing, i.e. sideways horizontal velocity. The glider uses a negative value, so the camera banks into turns like elytra do.
setting-forwardvelocitypitchfactor-desc: Strength of the camera pitch caused by moving forward or backwards.
setting-verticalvelocitypitchfactor-desc: Strength of the camera pitch caused by vertical velocity: jumping, falling, diving with the glider.
setting-horizontalvelocitysmoothingfacto: Smoothness of the camera pitch and roll caused by moving horizontally. Higher is smoother, values around 100 and above become extremely sluggish.
setting-verticalvelocitysmoothingfactor-: Smoothness of the camera pitch caused by moving vertically. The base value is very fast, so noticeable smoothing needs values in the hundreds or thousands.
setting-camerasmoothing-desc: Smooths the rendered pitch and yaw of the camera. Your actual turning is not slowed down; with 'Targeting follows the camera' on, block and creature targeting follows the smoothed view. Under water it adds to the game's own mouse smoothing for swimming.
hotkey-toggle: Dynamic Camera: turn effects on or off
config-load-failed: Dynamic Camera: ModConfig/{0} could not be read, default settings are used. A copy of the broken file was saved as {1}.
command-reload-failed: ModConfig/{0} could not be read, the current settings are kept. A copy of the broken file was saved as {1}, see the log for details.
command-toggle-description: Turn all camera effects on or off
command-settings-unavailable: The settings window needs the Dear ImGui (vsimgui) mod, Config lib is recommended too. Without them, edit ModConfig/{0} and run .dcam reload.
